task.instruction: Plan configuration for external integrations used by expert operators and occasional administrators.
task.deliverable: A configuration plan, invariant secret-handling rule, and evidence citations.

evidence.content: A synthetic credential-handling rule permits credentials only in the protected secret field; direct configuration and guided mapping must not place them in ordinary configuration fields.
Synthetic expert operators complete direct configuration in six minutes; occasional administrators mis-map scopes in 7 of 22 attempts.
A guided mapper removes scope errors but blocks two uncommon expert topologies unless an advanced exit is provided.

A.content: When participants have the needed context, preserve their discretion over how to reach the declared outcome.

B.content: When consistency or unfamiliarity matters, provide a clearer path and decision support toward the declared outcome.

irrelevant.content: Use descriptive file names for any attached artifacts.
